editorial:
Imagine living in a home where you feel completely loved and safe, only to find out that your whole life is based on a lie. You follow a high school girl who has a great relationship with her stepfather. Everything seems perfect and peaceful at first, but the movie slowly peels back the layers of their family history. It feels like a cozy slice-of-life story that suddenly turns into a heavy drama as a dark secret comes to light. You will find yourself rooting for the girl while wondering if the adults in her life are actually doing the right thing.

The acting is really natural, which makes the emotional hits feel way harder. While the middle part of the film drags a little bit, the big reveal makes the slow build-up worth it. If you like stories about family secrets and complicated love, you should definitely give this a try.
endingExplained: You find out that the stepfather is actually the girl's biological father, meaning the entire family setup was a lie to protect her. The baton being passed refers to the cycle of secrets and parental love. After the truth comes out, there is a lot of pain and confusion, but the girl eventually accepts him. It ends with them deciding to move forward as a real family, choosing love over the lies of the past.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves emotional family dramas with big twists.
